title: Integrate llmfit as a headless Model Manager provider projected natively in FA3 Control Center
decisions: llmfit is integrated under FA3 Model Manager rather than exposed as a separate user-facing application.
The normal user experience is native Qt/QML inside FA3 Control Center; llmfit TUI and web dashboard are diagnostic/developer fallbacks only.
The preferred same-host transport is HTTP over a Unix domain socket owned by the desktop user session.
llmfit hardware observations are OBSERVED_NON_AUTHORITATIVE fit inputs and never admission authority.
llmfit fit, speed, memory, quantization and runtime results are advisory estimates and never constitute production runtime conformance evidence by themselves.
A benchmark or placement request emitted by the GUI is a typed DRAFT_NOT_SUBMITTED ChangeSet carrying a workload-derived resource envelope.
CPU/memory-only workload drafts do not request accelerator discovery or accelerator lease.
Accelerator workload drafts require existing HRB authorization and a current scope-bound AcceleratorExecutionLease; conflict handling remains under FA3-ACCEL-GUARD-001 semantics.
Provider-local compatibility requirements may narrow execution compatibility but may not redefine the global hardware baseline.
Model placement remains hardware-agnostic at canonical level and is derived from declared workload requirements and authoritative current-host capabilities rather than fixed GPU model assumptions.
The provider is optional; the hardware-aware model-fit evaluation semantics are mandatory and may be implemented by another conforming provider.
